summary.text: Sylvia Jensen is a Democratic candidate for the Vermont House of Representatives, Grand Isle-Chittenden District (2 seats), in the November 3, 2026 general election, alongside Dave Skinner (D) and against incumbent Michael Morgan (R) and Josie Henry (R).
Ballotpedia lists her as an at-large member of the Champlain Islands Unified Union School District 66 board.
